title: Disable phantom output in Nouveau
summary: Fix display issues or suspend problems caused by the Nouveau driver detecting non-existent outputs (e.g., VGA-1) by disabling them via Xrandr or kernel parameters.
prerequisites: Identify the phantom output name (e.g., VGA-1) using xrandr

steps.explain: Disable the phantom output using xrandr. Replace <OUTPUT_NAME> with the detected phantom output (e.g., VGA-1).

placeholders.name: OUTPUT_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the phantom output to disable
